commands: OUT="$(TMPDIR=_tempdir_ mktemp -t pyinfra.XXXXXX)" &&  MODE="$(stat -c %a /home/someone/something 2>/dev/null || stat -f %Lp /home/someone/something 2>/dev/null)" && OWNER="$(stat -c "%u:%g" /home/someone/something 2>/dev/null || stat -f "%u:%g" /home/someone/something 2>/dev/null || echo $(id -un):$(id -gn))" && awk 'BEGIN {s=ARGV[2]; e=ARGV[3]; ARGV[2]=""; ARGV[3]=""} index($0, s) {r=1} r {if (index($0, e)) r=0; next} 1' /home/someone/something '# BEGIN PYINFRA BLOCK' '# END PYINFRA BLOCK' > $OUT  && mv "$OUT" /home/someone/something  && chown "$OWNER" /home/someone/something  && chmod "$MODE" /home/someone/something
